title: League Statistics
summary: For each team, compute matches played, points, goals for, goals against and goal difference, with 3 points for a win, 1 for a draw.
inputFormat: Teams(team_id, team_name); Matches(home_team_id, away_team_id, home_team_goals, away_team_goals).
outputFormat: Columns team_id, team_name, matches_played, points, goals_for, goals_against, goal_diff; sorted by points desc, goal_diff desc, team_name asc.
edgeRules: Teams without matches: draft says verify inclusion.

examples.text: authored-reference: team A beats B 2-1 -> A: 3 points, goal_diff +1; B: 0 points, goal_diff -1.
